questiontext.text:
MLA.USG.FND.4

Evidence organizer for this question
Source or scenario
“We the People” ordain and establish the Constitution.
Analysis lensIdentify the actor or idea, apply the named constitutional principle, and reject any conclusion broader than the supplied evidence.

Which conclusion most accurately applies popular sovereignty to this evidence?

Everything needed to answer is printed in this question; no previous page or lesson is required.

generalfeedback.text: popular sovereignty locates ultimate political authority in the people while channeling it through a binding constitutional system.

answer.text: Every policy must receive unanimous approval from all citizens.

feedback.text: This choice overgeneralizes the evidence or treats a limited principle as unlimited. popular sovereignty locates ultimate political authority in the people while channeling it through a binding constitutional system.

answer.text: A temporary majority may disregard protected rights.

feedback.text: This choice confuses a related constitutional concept with the one the evidence directly tests. popular sovereignty locates ultimate political authority in the people while channeling it through a binding constitutional system.

answer.text: Constitutional authority is grounded in the people, who create institutions and govern through constitutional procedures.

feedback.text: The answer is supported because popular sovereignty locates ultimate political authority in the people while channeling it through a binding constitutional system.

answer.text: Public officials may define their own powers after election.

feedback.text: This choice adds a conclusion that the source or scenario does not support. popular sovereignty locates ultimate political authority in the people while channeling it through a binding constitutional system.

questiontext.text:
